name: New York Ska-Jazz Ensemble

evidence.note: Club review says the sold-out audience danced, skanked, sang and clapped through the show.
Bio: created the ska-jazz style in 1994, 15 albums, many European tours.
Concert history shows ska and punk festival bookings.

dancing.notes: Ska beats get club crowds skanking (a bouncy freestyle dance), but this gig is at a French bistro, where most people will probably eat and listen.

description: Veteran New York band, formed in 1994, that mixes Jamaican ska and rocksteady beats with jazz solos and tours the US, Europe and beyond.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). The band's own shows page is out of date, so the Brasserie by Chef Aless (Massapequa) date could not be confirmed there; name match is strong. A restaurant gig may be a smaller lineup.

Directory research 2026-10-04: All current links confirmed from the official site. Booking email is the band's published booking agent address (Fred Reiter); management/press email nysjeofficial@gmail.com is an alternative. Current description and genres (ska, jazz, rocksteady) look right, so no change proposed; 'rocksteady' was not explicitly stated on the site. Their shows page still lists only 2025 dates, so the Long Island (Massapequa) gig could not be confirmed there. Instagram URL given without the share/tracking parameters the site uses.
